mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies are currently hovering over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 55 degrees. Under a Waxing Gibbous moon, we can expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

Starting Wednesday, September 23rd, contractors will begin chip seal road treatments on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, which will result in lane closures and traffic control. Additionally, several new development projects, including sites on Country View Court and Spring Rose Road, are scheduled for the Plan Commission meeting on October 5th.

Looking at our upcoming schedule, Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening tomorrow, followed by Tuesday trivia nights at both Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Also, the award-winning Verona Fall Fest kicks off this Friday, September 25th, at Hometown USA Festival Park.

In our weekly police report, on Thursday, September 10th, officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way. A 19-year-old male suspect who fired a handgun was detained, treated for injuries sustained while breaking a window, and jailed.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel. The store is scheduled to reopen tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM.
